lines.text: This burden was received in the year that King Hezekiah died.
The Philistines are told not to rejoice that the rod that struck them is broken.
The firstborn of the poor will find pasture, but the LORD will kill the Philistines' root by fire.
The gate must wail and the city cry out, for a cloud of smoke comes from the north.
The envoys are told that the LORD has founded Zion, where His afflicted people will find refuge.
